topic: Just one more episode! My child melts down when I turn off the screen before bed
video_title: Just one more episode! Screen before bed meltdown (2-6 years)
caption:
"Just one more episode!" My child melts down when I turn off the screen before bed.

Screens make it tougher to wind down at night, so big feelings at screen-off are really common.
For ages 2-6 years, the AAP advises turning screens off an hour before bed and keeping devices out of bedrooms.
Try a calm, kind line like: "Show's all done. Let's pick a book together."
